    Why Vanuatu

    What the program actually gives you

    Vanuatu's citizenship-by-investment program is built for speed and simplicity — here's what stands out.

    01

    90+ visa-free destinations

    Travel to Hong Kong, Singapore, and most of Southeast Asia without a prior visa.

    02

    Tax-friendly structure

    No personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax under Vanuatu's system.

    03

    Government-approved route

    A recognized citizenship-by-investment program, typically completed in 60–90 days.

    04

    Whole-family coverage

    Spouses and dependents can be included under a single application.

    05

    No residency requirement

    The entire process is handled remotely — no need to travel to or live in Vanuatu.

    06

    A legacy asset

    Citizenship that carries forward to your children — a long-term security move, not just travel convenience.

    Payment Structure

    A staged, transparent payment path

    • 01
      FIU ClearanceA $5,000 payment for the main applicant to begin clearance — typically 7 working days.
    • 02
      Partial Payment & Documentation25% is paid alongside your legal documents, forwarded together to the government.
    • 03
      Final ApprovalThe remaining 75% is paid once approved, releasing your certificate and passport.
